expect.why: every pointer resolves and the quotation is a span of its source
the one citation names a legal act and A0001 lists the document; the bare parenthesis and the id in running prose are not citations and are not read as ones
nothing has fallen and nothing is challenged

note: the near-negative of D59. A document may name an entry without citing it — in a parenthesis of its own, or in a sentence — and the rule that catches a citation with an illegal act must leave both alone, or every document that discusses its own ledger fails.
